programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in the past to kill the Dragon Master as she know that they were close friends back then.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition, he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish and discovers that it is Chi who captures them.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: A charming tale of child-creating complications, featuring a rare comedic performance by Alex Man Chi-leung.

programme.title: Behind The Yellow Line
programme.desc: Behind The Yellow Line

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl. But Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Chow stars as Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh joins the carefree Spinsters’ Club when she discovers her husband is having an affair. Despite the seemingly happy front that her sisters put on, beneath it all, each of them secretly yearns for a man in her life.

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, innkeeper Jade has disappeared and a new inn has risen from the ashes - one that's staffed by marauders masquerading as law-abiding citizens, who hope to unearth the fabled lost city buried in the desert.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: During the Japanese invasion of China, a wealthy martial artist is forced to leave his home when his city is occupied. With little means of providing for themselves, Ip Man and the remaining members of the city must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Best friends Bodil and Isabel, apparently happily married, sneak off for secret affairs using each other as an alibi. But when Isabel is killed when they were supposed to have been together. Bodil gets caught up in her own web of lies.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A regime shift in Leka stirs chaos. Police send undercover Zheng Zha into Song Bang’s gang, unaware others are waiting to strike back and settle old scores.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: As a man leaves his wife and daughter, a series of brief conversations, observed gestures, chance encounters and impulsive acts, tell the story of the relationships that flounder and thrive in the wake of this decision.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus accept a job from their landlord: kidnap a baby. Soon, the baby awakens strong paternal feelings in the two crooks, leading to complications when it comes to handing him over to his possibly crazy gang boss grandfather.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: The story is about a powerful drug-lord in southeast Asia, and the good guys have to save their loved ones under the threat of the Drug business conspiracy.

programme.title: Si Bocil Trang Quynh
programme.desc: Kisah Lucu Dan Jenaka Tentang Kehidupan Quynh Dan Orang-Orang Disekitarnya. Sebagai Anak Yang Nakal Tetapi Cerdas Dan Banyak Akal, Quynh Dan Teman-Temannya Akan Membawa Pengalaman Hidup Yang Penuh Warna Di Pedesaan Vietnam Pada Abad Ke-18. Menyoroti Juga Tentang Nilai-Nilai Budaya Rakyat Dan Hubungan Dengan Keluarga, Teman, Guru, Siswa, Dan Lingkungan. Trang Quynh Akan Membawa Tawa Bagi Penonton Dan Mengajarkan Mereka Tentang Keintiman, Persahabatan, Dan Nilai-Nilai Kemanusiaan.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings

programme.title: Blox Buster
programme.desc: Blox Buster Adalah Program Entertainment Yang Menghadirkan Keseruan Bermain Di Dunia Roblox, Platform Game Populer Dengan Jutaan Kreasi Dari Komunitas Global, Penonton Diajak Menjelajahi Berbagai Dunia Virtual Yang Penuh Warna, Menantang, Sekaligus Menyenangkan. Tidak Hanya Sekadar Bermain, Main Bareng Blox Juga Menyuguhkan Pengalaman Unik Dari Para Gamers Yang Ikut Serta, Mulai Dari Review Game, Tips Seru, Hingga Momen-Momen Kejutan Yang Terjadi Saat Bermain.

programme.title: Haikyu!! The Movie: The End And The Beginning
programme.desc: Pemain Voli Sma, Hinata, Bertekad Memenangkan Kejuaraan Nasional Dan Rela Bekerja Sama Dengan Mantan Rivalnya, Kageyama. Setelah Terinspirasi Oleh Raksasa Kecil Dari Sma Karasuno, Shouyou Hinata Bergabung Dengan Tim Voli Sekolah Meskipun Bertubuh Pendek. Namun, Ia Bertemu Kembali Dengan Tobio Kageyama, Setter Jenius Yang Pernah Mengalahkannya Di Smp. Rivalitas Mereka Membuat Tim Melarang Keduanya Bermain Hingga Bisa Bekerja Sama. Demi Membuktikan Kemampuan Mereka, Hinata Dan Kageyama Belajar Bekerja Sebagai Tim. Ketika Karasuno Diundang Untuk Pertandingan Latihan Dengan Sekolah Rival Lama, Persaingan Lama Pun Kembali Memanas.

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Yakni Gopal, Ying, Dan Yaya Yang Masing-Masing Memiliki Kekuatan Super. Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. Championship contenders will fight for crucial points in one of the season's demanding European rounds.

programme.title: 2026 The Asian Tournament
programme.desc: 2026 The Asian Tournament. Leading golfers from Asia and around the world compete on a challenging course, relying on precision, consistency, and smart course management in pursuit of the prestigious championship title and valuable ranking points.

Top men's and women's players will compete through intense rounds with the goal of claiming one of tennis's most prestigious Grand Slam titles.

programme.title: Dragon Inn: The City Of Sadness
programme.desc: Dragon Inn: The City of Sadness follows a secret organization operating behind the façade of a Chinese restaurant known as Dragon Inn. Its members dedicate themselves to punishing criminals whom the legal system has failed to bring to justice. Each member carries a troubled past and a personal reason for joining the group. Their mission becomes increasingly complicated when the son of a powerful businessman is murdered and one of Dragon Inn’s own members becomes a suspect. As hidden motives, betrayals, and violent confrontations emerge, the organization finds itself fighting not only external enemies but also internal conflicts that threaten its survival.

programme.title: Love Barista
programme.desc: Love Barista follows Kang Jun-woo, a Korean celebrity whose career is beginning to decline. While traveling to Vietnam for a commercial shoot, a series of mishaps leaves him stranded without money, a passport, or his manager. As he struggles to adapt to his unfamiliar surroundings, he meets Thao, a cheerful young woman pursuing her dream of becoming a barista. Despite their cultural and language differences, the two gradually develop a meaningful connection. Through humor, friendship, and romance, the film explores second chances, personal growth, and the unexpected relationships that can change a person's life.
